content: {"action":"write_off","reasoning":"The remaining balance stems from CO-197 because required prior authorization was missing, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. The claim has already been adjudicated, so resubmission would violate the payer's duplicate-claim rule, and billing the patient would exceed the contractual patient share. With no valid payer remedy remaining, the balance should be written off."}
